messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 - High error rate detected on /v1/generate in us-west-2. Alerting on-call rotation and opening war room: https://meet.example.com/room/ri-5001234567. Pager sent to oncall.

maria: on it — joining war room now. acked pager.

kevin: joining. I see spikes in 5xx and tail latency in the runtime dashboards.

sophie: I'll take incident owner. Initial triage: model runner processes throwing grpc timeouts, some upstream model replicas OOM/restarts. Customer impact: hosted text generation requests in US-West experiencing failures and degraded throughput.

maria: paging confirmed to rotation @kevin (oncall), @sophie assigned as owner. :thumbsup:

kevin: immediate mitigation plan: 1) scale runtime replicas in us-west 2) enable routing fallback to us-east for non-enterprise traffic 3) temporarily tighten per-tenant qps to protect control plane. Executing step 1 now.

kevin: running: `kubectl -n ri-prod scale deploy/ri-runtime-us-west --replicas=+3`

eng-ops-bot: scale job started for ri-runtime-us-west -> target replicas: 18. logs: https://logs.example.com/ri/runtime/5001234567

kevin: scale finished, replicas at 18. observed short spike during restart windows but overall capacity increased.

sophie: drafting statuspage and customer notify. Suggested statuspage message: "Investigating: Increased errors and timeouts for text generation in US-West. Engineers are applying mitigations (scaling and routing fallbacks). We will provide updates every 15 minutes." Add ETA for next update?

maria: add next update in 15m. also include support link and contact for priority customers.

sophie: customer notification template (prio customers): ```Hi — we’re investigating an issue impacting text generation in the US-West region which may cause request failures or slower responses. Our engineers are actively mitigating the problem (scaling and routing fallbacks). We will update you within 15 minutes. If you are seeing production errors, please reply to this message or open a support ticket: https://support.redwood.com/5001234567. — Redwood Inference Status Team```

maria: sending to priority list now, cc @sales-ops.

kevin: step 2: enabled routing fallback for non-enterprise routes -> `PATCH /routing` applied, traffic steering to us-east fallback for low-priority keys. Observed error rate drop: 5xx from ~12% -> ~3.6% (first 3m).

eng-ops-bot: metrics snapshot: error_rate=3.6% latency_p95=420ms. See dashboard: https://dashboards.example.com/ri/incident/5001234567

sophie: good progress. I'll continue statuspage updates and coordinate customer comms. Assign escalation path: if errors >5% for next 10m, escalate to infra lead @alex.

maria: noted. keeping war room open: https://meet.example.com/room/ri-5001234567 — leaving to monitor, will rejoin on updates.

kevin: monitoring, will report next update at 5001234625 (in ~8 minutes).

incident-bot: Next scheduled update requested at 5001234625.
